purpose: Defines six progressive levels of SCRIPT DIFFICULTY used to qualify sound-cue interpretation providers. This file is configuration only: it contains no scores, no provider results and no measured model quality claims. Levels qualify exclusively on human-reviewed provider responses; synthetic material, failed or incomplete responses and provisional-unreviewed gold never qualify.

evidenceKinds.MODEL_PROVIDER_RESPONSES: Qualifying only when the stated gold review status is HUMAN_REVIEWED: event scores were derived from responses returned by the named provider run and were reviewed by a person.
evidenceKinds.SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: Never qualifies: illustrative or deterministic fixture material, not a provider response.
evidenceKinds.GENERATED_DEMO: Never qualifies: demo or generated content, not a response from the target provider.
evidenceKinds.MISSING: Never qualifies: no usable response accounting exists.

goldReviewStatuses.HUMAN_REVIEWED: Only qualifying status: every gold annotation used was reviewed by a person.
goldReviewStatuses.PROVISIONAL_UNREVIEWED: Treated as insufficient evidence for progression decisions, whatever the scores.

caseCompletionStatuses.COMPLETE: Every scene window of the scenario was answered by the provider and the whole scenario appears in the scored report.
caseCompletionStatuses.INCOMPLETE: Some scene windows are still missing; the whole scenario is excluded from scoring because scripts span multiple model requests.
caseCompletionStatuses.FAILED: The provider run errored; the scenario provides no quality evidence for this milestone.
caseCompletionStatuses.MISSING: No provider response was obtained at all for the scenario.

criticalErrorCategories.basis: A gold forbiddenPlayLineIds line (a mentioned-only or practical stage sound) was turned into a PLAY cue.
A prediction referenced a source line that does not exist in the original script (exact-tuple HALLUCINATED_SOURCE issue).
An expected STOP or CONTINUE directive was missed or replaced at its exact source line; under exact-tuple scoring that produces a MISSED_EXPECTED_EVENT issue with transport STOP or CONTINUE.

levels.name: Explicit versus false positives
levels.focus: Explicit sound cues versus false positives: PLAY on real cues only, never on mentions or practical sounds.

levels.name: Transport and continuity
levels.focus: PLAY, STOP, CONTINUE, SILENCE cues plus loops and fades.

levels.name: Ambiguity and dramatic context
levels.focus: Ambiguous stage directions and dramatic context.

levels.name: Performance formats
levels.focus: Theatre, galas, musicals, dance, circus and conferences.

levels.name: Long adversarial material
levels.focus: Long, multilingual, multi-window and adversarial scripts.

levels.name: Independent held-out final evaluation
levels.focus: Independent held-out final evaluation: reporting only; never used for tuning and never unlocks a level.
